purpose: Location userinfo: a protocol-relative redirect carrying credentials must be reported (old pattern required a scheme).

groundTruth.rationale: The protocol-relative Location contains a userinfo segment, so credentials are disclosed in redirects and logs even without an explicit scheme.

limitations: Observation mode: the fixture is a synthetic HTTP observation object, not a live request or a real target.
The case proves the declared DAST check evaluates as stated on this observation; it does not prove exploitability.
